content.thinking: My generator's bug: draw 65693 > 65535. Let me fix the generator to use `rng.randint(0, 65535)`.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && sed -i "s/rng.choice(\[0, 0, rng.randint(0, 70000)\])/rng.choice([0, 0, rng.randint(0, 65535)])/" tools/gen2.py && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout -s KILL 900 python3 -Bu tools/runtests2.py 300 21 small 2>&1 | tail -6
